About Azivor

Curiosity is better with a test.

AI tools are changing quickly. For students, it can be hard to tell which new abilities are useful and what they actually take to use well.

Why this exists

Azivor is a student-led project for trying those possibilities in real creative and technical work. We build small things, look closely at the process, and share what the result can and cannot do.

The aim is to help another student move from hearing about a capability to making an informed attempt of their own.
